name: Disable Samsung telemetry, ACR, voice and account services
description: Masks data-service/pushd/bms/appbinary-manager units, plants vendor opt-out switches, kills the ACR service app, Bixby/voice stack, SSO and CIS processes at every boot, supervises a 30s watchdog, and hijacks the TVPlus button into the manager. Disable via the manager or the disabled flag; revival needs a reboot.
author: levkropp
